_about: Documented behavioural notes that a schema diff cannot express. Each entry cites its source. Keys: '<METHOD> <path> <request property>'.

POST /v1/checkout/sessions payment_metho.note: Replacement allowed_payment_method_types silently filters incompatible payment methods instead of returning an error; non-default methods may need enabling in the Dashboard (dynamic payment methods). Whether allowed_payment_method_types itself requires Dashboard enablement is NOT VERIFIED. A rename alone can change which methods customers see: human review required.
